title: Horse dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='62' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#8B4513'/>
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#A0522D'/>

  <rect x='37' y='80' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3D2B1F'/>
  <rect x='57' y='80' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#4A3728'/>

  <rect x='30' y='55' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#8B4513' transform='rotate(-15 33 65)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='50' width='7' height='18' rx='3' fill='#A0522D' transform='rotate(25 69 59)'/>

  <rect x='27' y='72' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3D2B1F' transform='rotate(-15 31 74)'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='16' ry='9' fill='#B8652E'/>

  <path d='M70 48 Q82 42 84 55 Q86 48 80 46 Q88 44 82 38' stroke='#5C3317' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='32' cy='28' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#A0522D'/>

  <ellipse cx='25' cy='33' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#C4793E'/>

  <circle cx='22' cy='33' r='1.5' fill='#3D2B1F'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='30.8' cy='25.2' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <path d='M36 18 L39 12 L41 19 Z' fill='#8B4513'/>

  <path d='M40 22 Q45 26 43 33' fill='none' stroke='#7A4A2A' stroke-width='2'/>
